name: SLR-Bench-German
description:
🧠 SLR-Bench-German: Scalable Logical Reasoning Benchmark (German Edition)
	





	
		
	
	
		SLR-Bench Multilingual Versions:
	








SLR-Bench-German is the German-language pendant of the original SLR-Benchdataset.
It follows the same symbolic structure, evaluation framework, and curriculum as the English version but provides all natural-language task prompts translated into German.

reputation: An extension of the SLR-Bench family for German; used in logical-reasoning evaluation and research with growing recognition in multilingual reasoning benchmarks.
